facts.fact: 2024-10-09 男主进 Lyke 村采购食品杂货并订购燃料
facts.anchor: Went into the village today. Bought groceries and ordered some fuel.

facts.fact: 他订购三十袋固体燃料，约定一周内送达
facts.anchor: Thirty bags of solid fuel, to be delivered within the week

facts.fact: 夜里狐狸嚎叫，荒原上猎物应当很多
facts.anchor: Foxes screaming in the night. Must be lots of prey on the moor.

facts.fact: 咖啡店门口有雕刻南瓜与纸骨架串，提醒他万圣节只剩三周
facts.anchor: A row of carved pumpkins by the door and a garland of paper skeletons reminded him that Halloween was just three weeks away.

facts.fact: 「the walk」是四十英里穿越 Scarth Wood Moor 到 Ravenscar、须在二十四小时内走完的著名路线
facts.anchor: Forty miles across Scarth Wood Moor and all the way to Ravenscar. You’re meant to do it in twenty-four hours. It’s famous.

facts.fact: 回家路上他想起 Arthur 日记里「这些荒原上有步行者」
facts.anchor: One the way back with his groceries, he thought of Arthur’s diary. There are walkers on these moors.

facts.fact: 窗外一个女孩声音说「You can’t just ignore us, Dad」
facts.anchor: You can’t just ignore us, Dad, said a voice just outside the window.

facts.fact: 女孩叫他 Arthur，把他认成了另一个人
